flags.message: Frozen band is 'state' (sal-v4), but the petitioners are a federal immigration-detention warden and federal officials represented by the Solicitor General (counsel of record on the snapshot). The caption classifier appears to read 'Warden' as a state marker. The petition belongs to the 'federal' class (pooled reached rate ~73% vs ~24% for 'state'), so skill scored against the state yardstick will be distorted.
